title: 鲸鱼在水里怎么呼吸 · 素材
subtitle: 给对比页用的单体素材
style: children's picture book illustration, oil pastel drawing with thick waxy strokes and blunt smudged edges, deep sea blue, pale grey and bright teal

pages.scene: One single sperm whale swimming, seen from the side facing left, a huge blunt square head and one flipper, its whole body inside the picture. The background is one flat cream colour of a single even tone that fills the whole picture right out to all four edges. The object floats on this flat colour: it casts no shadow and rests on no ground, and there is no darker patch, wash, puddle, base, line or platform of any kind underneath it. There is no sky, no horizon, no clouds and no scenery of any kind behind it: the cream colour is the only thing behind the object, exactly as if the object had been cut out and laid on blank paper.
